speaker: Doctor
text: The normal adrenal ultrasound and steroid precursors effectively rule out Lipoid Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia, as StAR deficiency would present with absent adrenal glands and elevated 17-ketosteroids. Given the 46,XX karyotype, primary amenorrhea, severe virilization, and bone fragility, this clinical picture is most consistent with Aromatase Deficiency, which causes estrogen deficiency leading to osteopenia and failure of breast development. DIAGNOSIS READY: Aromatase Deficiency
